newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - CANTV Q2 shr lower.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - CANTV Q2 shr lower.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Full company name is Compania Anonima Nacional Telefonos de Venezuela.
All figures in U.S. dollars, converted from the Venezuela bolivar at a rate of $1.00 per 487.75 bolivars, the daily exchange rate on June 30.
1997 Q2 earnings per ADS were $0.60 against $1.61 for the same period last year. One ADS represents seven shares.

1997 Q2 shr and ADS figures were lower due to a non-recurring charge resulting from a reform of the Venezuelan National Labor Law and "substantially lower" non-cash inflation gains in the quarter compared to the same period last year. Excluding the reform and accounting change, the shr figure would have been $0.13 and the ADS figure $0.89.
